versions.changelog:
Initial release of "value-alignment" skill: a standards-based, local value-guard for content generation.

- Implements "helpful/harmless/honest" scoring to assess generated text before output.
- Blocks harmful or out-of-bounds outputs and flags overpromising or unfounded assertions.
- Uses heuristic (regex-based) patterns for detection; integrates with self-improving learning module.
- Outputs principle scores, issue list, and overall pass/fail status for publishing gatekeeping.
- Built for easy integration, auditability, and local execution—part of a three-layer trust framework.
